## AsrSession.onPartial() method

Subscribe to in-progress transcripts. \*\*Not emitted in v1\*\* — whisper.cpp's batch shape and the cost of per-window encoder passes mean Moss currently only emits finals. Returning a no-op unsubscribe lets caller code be written for the future without breaking when partials are eventually wired.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onPartial(callback: (event: AsrPartialEvent) => void): UnsubscribeFn;
```
